settings.title: Room Settings
settings.description: Update room settings and modify the behavior of the chat
settings.compactSkipped: Nothing to compact — conversation is already concise
settings.compactedAboveTooltip: Earlier messages were summarized to reduce context size

strategyTooltip.SUMMARY: Replaces older messages with an AI-generated summary. Preserves the overall context of the conversation while freeing up token space.
strategyTooltip.TOOL_PRUNE: Removes verbose tool call results from the conversation history. Best when tool outputs are large and the details are no longer needed.
strategyTooltip.AUTO: Will select summarization or tool pruning based on the current conversation.

form.modelEmpty: No models available. A connected model only appears here once it is tagged "text-generation" in its engine settings.

project.empty: No CODE projects yet. Create one to keep this session's work in a real app.
project.createDescription: Creates a CODE project and publishes it, so the agent's work lands in a real app that shows up in the catalog.
project.nameHelp: Used as the project name in the app catalog.

harness.label: Agent harness
harness.description: Which agent loop runs your messages.
harness.shellCaution: Runs its own tools outside this room's toolbox, including shell commands. Scope is set by the deployment's agent sandbox policy.

claude_code.label: Claude Code

github_copilot_py.label: GitHub Copilot

contextWindow.descriptionLow: All conversations have a limit. Very long conversations will eventually cause the model to forget earlier messages.
contextWindow.descriptionMedium: This conversation is getting long. If it continues, the model will start forgetting earlier messages. Consider compacting this conversation or starting a new chat soon.
contextWindow.descriptionHigh: This conversation is nearly full. The model will soon start forgetting earlier messages. Compact this conversation or start a new chat to continue with full context.
contextWindow.descriptionExceeded: This conversation has exceeded its limit. The model is now forgetting earlier messages. Compact this conversation or start a new chat for best results.
